description: Add CSS custom properties for spacing/touch targets and enhance responsive breakpoints across all CSS files. This foundation enables consistent responsive design and ensures all interactive elements meet 44px minimum touch targets for mobile accessibility.
steps: 1. Add spacing and touch target CSS custom properties to styles/style.css :root block: --touch-min: 44px, --space-xs through --space-3xl spacing tokens, and fluid typography tokens using clamp()
2. Add mobile portrait breakpoint (@media max-width: 479px) to styles/style.css with hero section adjustments, container padding fixes, and touch target fixes for .cta-btn and .secondary-btn
3. Add small mobile breakpoint (@media max-width: 319px) to styles/style.css for foldable narrow viewports with .hero-title and .nav-links adjustments
4. Add tablet portrait and mobile breakpoints to styles/services.css for .services-grid (already has 1100px, add 700px and 480px), .delivery-cards grid, and .search-bar width adjustments
5. Add mobile breakpoints to styles/insights.css for .subpage-dock positioning, .stream-buttons-grid layout (stack on mobile), .form-input-group stacking, and .preview-card-glass grid

6. Add mobile breakpoints to styles/about.css for .hero-stats-grid (2 columns on tablet, 1 on mobile), .serve-grid adjustments, .principles-layout stacking, .why-grid-6 grid, and .team-carousel-slide sizing
7. Add touch target fixes to styles/header.css: ensure .header-menu-toggle and .header-nav a have min-height: 44px on mobile (already has 44px hamburger, verify nav links)
8. Add touch target fixes to styles/footer.css: ensure .footer-col a has min-height: 44px on mobile (already has good responsive, verify touch targets)
9. Add mobile breakpoints to styles/contact.css for form field touch targets (min-height: 44px for inputs) and button sizing (already has 860px, 560px breakpoints - add touch target fixes)
10. Add mobile breakpoints to styles/our-services.css and styles/why-us.css if they exist - ensure grids stack on mobile and touch targets are 44px minimum
acceptance_criteria: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) have minimum 44px touch targets on viewports <= 768px
No horizontal overflow on any viewport width from 320px to 1024px
CSS custom properties for spacing and touch targets defined in style.css :root
All CSS files have appropriate media queries for tablet portrait (768px) and mobile portrait (480px) breakpoints
Typography scales appropriately using clamp() or media query adjustments
verification: Open each HTML file in Chrome DevTools and test at 320px, 375px, 480px, 600px, 768px widths
Verify no horizontal scrollbar appears at any viewport width
Use DevTools to inspect touch targets - all interactive elements should be at least 44px in both dimensions
Check that grids collapse to fewer columns appropriately as viewport narrows
findings:
Successfully added CSS custom properties for touch targets (--touch-min: 44px) and spacing tokens (--space-xs through --space-3xl) to styles/style.css :root. Added fluid typography tokens using clamp(). Enhanced responsive breakpoints across all CSS files:

- styles/style.css: Added 479px and 319px breakpoints with touch target fixes for buttons
- styles/services.css: Added 700px breakpoint for tablet portrait, enhanced 480px breakpoint with touch targets
- styles/insights.css: Enhanced 768px breakpoint and added 480px breakpoint with touch target fixes for stream-btn, email-input, notify-btn
- styles/about.css: Enhanced 768px breakpoint and added 480px breakpoint for hero-stats-grid, serve-grid, principles-layout, why-grid-6, team-carousel-slide
- styles/contact.css: Added touch target fixes at 560px breakpoint for form inputs and button (font-size: 16px to prevent iOS zoom)
- styles/why-us.css: Added 480px breakpoint with touch target fixes
- styles/our-services.css: Enhanced 480px breakpoint with touch target fixes
- styles/header.css: Added min-height: 44px to nav links

All interactive elements now reference --touch-min custom property for consistent 44px minimum touch targets. Note: Manual testing in Chrome DevTools recommended to verify no horizontal overflow at all viewport widths.
